description: Universal Creative Component Library — 29 reusable component definitions across 4 creative domains (Graphic, Interior, Fashion, Packaging).

schemaExportsRequested.note: The domain-local table definition lives inside the service file. Team 24 should promote it to lib/db/src/schema/ai-design-components.ts and export from the barrel (lib/db/src/schema/index.ts) when ready. The service will then update its import to @workspace/db.

migrations.description: Creates ai_platform.ai_design_components table with indexes and unique constraint on (tenant_id, slug). Additive only.

integrationNotes: Apply migration/team-08.sql before starting the API server to ensure the ai_design_components table exists.
Mount the router under the /api prefix that the api-server already uses (result: /api/ai/design-components/*).
The router uses adminAuth middleware at router-level; no additional auth wiring is needed in routes/index.ts.
After barrel promotion (schemaExportsRequested above), update the import in designComponentService.ts from the local pgSchema definition to '@workspace/db'.
The frontend page (pagesToRegister) fetches from /api/ai/design-components/registry. It degrades gracefully (shows error state) if the router is not yet mounted.
Do NOT pass tenantId from client body/query to any route — tenantId is resolved server-side via resolveAuthenticatedTenantContext.

knownRisks.risk: designComponentService.ts uses a domain-local pgSchema definition. If the barrel is promoted before this service is updated, ensure imports are swapped to avoid duplicate table definitions.

The ai_design_components table must be created before the API server starts or POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE instance routes will fail with 'relation does not exist'. Registry and validate routes are stateless and safe regardless.
